integrity: The abstract kernel lemma is proved analytically; the Fock corollary uses the stated, verified hypotheses of the referenced 2026 kernel representation and nonvanishing theorem. No external certification claimed.
limitations: Only one-variable jointly exponential-type kernels and harmonic finite-product Fock operators on the common invariant domain; no boundedness, Schatten or several-variable assertion.
Preprint input from arXiv:2610.30209v1 is assumed as published theorem; no independent external audit.
title: Infinite separation rank of exponential-type Fock kernels
